look_here_first: Inspect the basal rosette: deeply pinnately lobed and spinulose-toothed leaves, then the leafless scape bearing 1–3 heads with 25–53 disk florets.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas state-native; no verified three-county project PASS.

morphology_keys.heads: One to three rayless heads with 25–53 disk florets.
morphology_keys.habit: Low rosette perennial, leafless flowering scape.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. wrightii has taller leafy stems and unlobed toothed cauline leaves, with 8–12 florets/head.
